messages:
elaine: Quick sync — planning to deprecate the legacy 'envelope' framing for chat streaming and migrate to the new 'chat-stream-v2' wire. Proposed approach: header opt-in + server-side translator + cohorted cutover. Thoughts? :eyes:

mike: +1 for header opt-in. SDKs must switch before we flip the default. Need migration cohorts, a kill-switch, and a rollback path.

sarah: Agree. Telemetry first: emit a per-request tag rw.stream.client_version and a translation counter (envelope->v2). Also surface a latency delta metric specifically for translated requests.

raj: Question: function-calling payloads differ — envelope had separate meta object, v2 embeds meta inline. Translator mapping is doable but may reorder chunks. We need to preserve chunk ordering guarantees.

elaine: Translator will be conservative: map envelope.meta -> v2.meta, keep original chunk boundaries, and avoid coalescing chunks. Aim for idempotence so retries are safe.

noa: Ops note — earlier proxy translations caused CPU spikes (see past rollout). I'll run a microbenchmark and draft resource estimates. Also recommend a horizontal autoscaling policy for translator pods.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: interop-translator v0.1 -> staging :rocket:

mike: For SDKs: publish opt-in release (npm/pypi) that sets X-RW-Stream-Version: v2. Include example code and migration notes.

sarah: Some middleboxes strip custom headers. We should support a query param fallback (e.g., ?stream=v2) for 8 weeks during migration.

elaine: Good call. We'll support query fallback for the first 2 months. Also add a response header X-RW-Compat: translator-active when server translation occurs so clients can detect extra processing.

raj: Rollout plan (proposal):
- Week 0: header & query opt-in available + SDK beta
- Week 2: tenant opt-in via admin UI + toggle exposed to SEs
- Week 6: cohort A (10%) traffic diverted to v2 via router policy
- Week 12: analyze regressions and metrics; if green, expand to 50%
- Week 20: flip default to v2 with 30-day rollback window

noa: Action items:
- @mike publish SDK beta + release notes
- @sarah add telemetry, dashboards, regression alerts
- @elaine expose tenant toggle + rollback button in admin UI
- @raj implement translator idempotence and chunk-preservation tests
- @noa run perf benchmark and open infra ticket for autoscaling

mike: I'll handle SDKs + docs PR. Will coordinate a breaking-change advisory and notify partner integrators.

sarah: I'll add dashboard panels for translation rate, translation latency delta, p50/p95, error rate, and a tokenization drift check. Also add an alert when translation CPU > 70% for 5m.

elaine: TL;DR: header opt-in + query fallback, server-side translator during migration, telemetry and cohorted rollout, flip default after monitoring. :thumbsup:

raj: One last ask: include a compatibility test in the E2E suite that runs a small set of prompts against both formats and diff outputs automatically. That will catch semantic drift early.

elaine: Agree — add to integration pipeline. Also add a small scoreboard for semantic diffs (pass/warn/fail).

noa: Filing infra ticket INF-4321 for translator autoscaling and perf test results.

mike: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

sarah: dashboard draft: https://dashboards.internal/stream-v2-metrics

elaine: Thanks team. We'll sync Friday 10am to finalize the operator runbook and rollback checklist. :calendar:
